question: APPROVE E4's build plan. Four asks. FIRST, the delivery shape: TWO PRs split on cargento_runtime/web/ and nothing else — PR 1 carries the SECURITY.md promotion, the probe, the published field and the docs; PR 2 carries the render and the two byte-pin oracle sets. Both belong to E4 and the issue is not Done until PR 2 lands. SECOND, the review tiers, which are not an override of anything: reading the AGENTS.md table literally gives a different row per PR, so PR 1 takes full adversarial and PR 2 takes two lenses plus an arbiter. Your earlier reduction is explicitly NOT extended, because it applied to an issue that described a future handler and PR 1 is the handler. THIRD, three drafted corrections to E4's own body and one to its milestone. FOURTH, and this one is separate: DRC-4122's amendment section carries the same wrong predicate this triage refuted, and a correction note there was not authorized at the previous gate, so it is reported without a draft and left to you.

artifacts.summary:
Twelve claims in E4's body were re-derived against origin/main at 701b7f0. Nine reproduce, three are falsified, and two facts nobody had written down were found by reading the tip rather than the issue.

Of the two defects the dispatch named, one was E4's and one was the FO's. The six-of-ten-harnesses sentence is wrong twice over: the count is eight, and the predicate is wrong because Codex and Antigravity have adapters and still cannot emit. The root cause was found rather than guessed — the sentence was carried over from observation.finished_at's docstring, where six IS the right number for a different question, one about any overlay-producing event. It is drafted as a property rather than a count, and the reason is sharper than before: Droid and Goose emit SessionEnd natively and are unreachable only for want of an adapter, so any number ages badly. But the six --no-spacedock sites figure REPRODUCES, and the groundwork cycle's three was the miscount: cli.py twice, config.py three times, lifecycle.py once, with --no-usage occupying the identical six as the independent check. The FO passed that wrong figure along as fact and this stage refuted it.

Two constraints the merged contract does not name, both build-shaping. The session-end edge runs on the HTTP handler thread, under the coordinator lock, behind a two-second client timeout — so a synchronous probe would stall every other event and time out the harness's own hook. And session_ended mints no overlay at all, so the result has no carrier and must follow finished_at's side-channel pattern through all three update blocks of the reducer.

One cycle-1 acceptance criterion was unsound rather than merely incomplete: it proposed proving the null surface on a row whose acquisition is scan-only, but that marker is set only for harnesses absent from the identity normalizers, so the test would pass while leaving two of the eight unprobeable rows unchecked. Rewritten to require one of them.

Eleven acceptance criteria, offline and interactive split declared, one interactive with the reason no harness will automate it. Every Verified by names a test file and line, a shipped command, or a commit-shape check.

The shape is forced by contention that was measured rather than assumed: the PR queue is clear of web/, but two live sibling worktrees already carry web diffs against origin/main, 76 files and 30 files. E4 would be the third writer into a surface holding 56 pinned figures with no script that emits them. The promotion constraint is not broken by the split, because the promoted section describes running the probe and publishing two fields, both of which PR 1 ships, so SECURITY.md is true at every commit and the plan doc dies in the same commit that promotes it.

Nothing was written to Linear and no repository file was touched; the tip was read through git show rather than by checking out.
